integrity.finite_checks: two independently constructed enumeration programs; finite corroboration, not an infinite certificate

scientific_limitations: The statement classifies all shortest-path rerouting graphs in Johnson graphs and gives their diameter, radius, cliques and basic counts. It does not give the exact metric between each individual pair of paths nor a formula for the number of optimal reroutings. Historical priority remains subject to identification of equivalent unindexed publications.
title: Four-way rerouting cliques and sharp diameter for Johnson-graph geodesics
